api.reactSignature: { children, label, selectedLabel, requiredMessage, selectedOptions, defaultSelectedOptions, selectedValues, defaultSelectedValues, inputValue, open, defaultOpen, positioning, disableAutoFocus = false, inline = false, noPopover = false, disabled, onOpenChange, onOptionSelect, onInputValueChange, onChange, ...props }: TagPickerProps

relatedReactApis.name: TagPickerProps.requiredMessage
relatedReactApis.description: Sets the native form validation message; defaults to SharePointUIProvider.strings.required.

relatedReactApis.name: TagPickerProps.selectedLabel
relatedReactApis.description: Names the selected-options group; defaults to SharePointUIProvider.strings.selectedOptionsLabel.

relatedReactApis.name: TagPickerProps.selectedOptions
relatedReactApis.description: Controls the selected option values; use defaultSelectedOptions for an uncontrolled initial selection.

relatedReactApis.name: TagPickerProps.positioning
relatedReactApis.description: Positions and sizes the options surface within viewport or clipping-ancestor boundaries; supports placement, alignment, fallbacks, offsets, and custom bounds.

relatedReactApis.name: TagPickerProps.disableAutoFocus
relatedReactApis.description: Keeps the first matching option inactive until keyboard navigation selects one.

component.summary: Search, choose, and remove multiple values with keyboard, native form support, and popup placement that adapts to SharePoint sections.
highValueAdditions: Add composed control, input, selected-tag group, and list primitives while preserving the single state engine.
